heading: Thursday, July 10, 2025
topLine: Mistral releases Devstral Medium and Devstral Small 1.1.

items.headline: Mistral releases Devstral Medium and Devstral Small 1.1
items.summary: Mistral released Devstral Medium, an API model scoring 61.6% on SWE-Bench Verified by its own measurement, and Devstral Small 1.1, a 24B Apache 2.0 model scoring 53.6%. Mistral claims Devstral Medium beats Gemini 2.5 Pro and GPT-4.1 on cost-performance.
